rawContent: You can’t look at this and think, “yeah, that’s ok, it’s supposed to look like this, right...?” without an empty feeling in your stomach. Change is here, it just hasn’t hit you yet. It will when it gets worse. #ClimateEmergency #ClimateStrike #ClimateActionNow

What would you miss? Does the average person see this? What specific extinction would make it all real for the average person? How many have to disappear before the average person decides enough is enough? And would it be far too late by then? #ClimateAction #ClimateCrisis
